target: Node v24.13.0 markTransferMode for internal/fs/promises FileHandle
finding: js_transferable assigns mode through transfer_mode_private_symbol. env_properties declares it PER_ISOLATE_PRIVATE_SYMBOL_PROPERTIES, env.cc serializes/deserializes it as v8::Private, and node_util exports that same Private through ObjectTemplate. It must not be replaced by a normal reflectable Symbol. Exact set/create/proxy/extensibility semantics remain to be mapped before a native implementation.
